documents.title: Ajaia Q4 AI Product Roadmap
documents.content:
Ajaia Q4 AI Product Roadmap

Welcome to Ajaia Docs — a lightweight, AI-native collaborative workspace built for rapid product execution.

Core Priorities

  • Real-time Document Workflows: Fast rich-text editing with zero-friction persistence.
  • Seamless File Ingestion: Upload .md, .txt, or .docx files directly into structured drafts.
  • Granular Access Control: Share documents across team members with Edit or View-Only permissions.

Next Steps

  1. Review architecture tradeoffs in the sidebar.
  2. Switch between seeded team accounts in the top navigation bar to test sharing permissions.
  3. Try uploading a local Markdown or Word document!

documents.title: Engineering Architecture RFC: Agentic Workflows
documents.content:
Engineering Architecture RFC

Authored by Sarah Chen and shared with Aryarajsinh for technical review.

1. Context

We need a resilient orchestration layer that combines deterministic validation with LLM-assisted synthesis.

2. Proposed Guardrails

  • Strict schema validation on all API boundaries
  • Role-based access control at the persistence layer
